title: Add Loading States
summary: Adds loading, empty and error states to a view that fetches data, using the spinners, skeletons and messages the app already has.
description: Many screens handle only the success case, so users see a blank area while data loads or a frozen page when a request fails. This command finds the data flow in the view you name and covers the three missing states.
It reuses the existing skeletons, banners and copy style of the app, and it keeps retry behavior simple and visible.
useWhen: A list or dashboard shows a blank area while the request is in flight
A failed request leaves the page silent
New accounts see an empty table with no hint about what to do
You are polishing a screen before release
body:
Add loading, empty and error states to the view: $ARGUMENTS

1. Read the view and trace where its data comes from (hook, loader, store, fetch call). Note what the code currently does while pending, on an empty result and on failure.
2. Search the codebase for existing patterns: skeleton or spinner components, empty-state illustrations, error banners, toast helpers. Reuse them; create a new component only if none exists.
3. Implement: a loading state that matches the final layout size to avoid jumps; an empty state with a short message and the next action; an error state with the reason in plain words and a retry button that calls the same fetch.
4. Mark loading regions with `aria-busy` and announce errors with `role="alert"`. Do not show a spinner for requests under about 300 ms if the app has a delay helper.
5. Add or update tests for the three states using the project's mocking approach.

Run the tests and type check. Report which states were missing, what was reused, and anything in the data layer you did not change.

example.result:
Added: TableSkeleton while pending (existing component), EmptyState "No invoices yet. Create one" with a link, ErrorBanner with Retry wired to refetch().
Tests added for all three (Invoices.test.tsx). tsc and vitest pass. The export-to-CSV button still has no error state.

faq.question: Will it invent new components?
faq.answer: Only when it cannot find an existing skeleton, banner or empty state. It searches first and says what it reused.

faq.question: Does it change my API calls?
faq.answer: No. It reads the data flow and reports weaknesses it sees in the data layer, but edits only the view and its tests.

access: Reads the view, its data layer and shared UI components
Edits the view and its test file
